newsitem.title: USA: Voxel alleges Genl Scanning breaches pact.
newsitem.headline: Voxel alleges Genl Scanning breaches pact.

text.p: Voxel alleged Tuesday that General Scanning Inc, manufacturer of the Voxcam imager, is in breach of the contract between the companies.
GSI has failed to meet engineering specifications, product performance requirements and scheduled delivery dates, and Voxel is seeking redress, Voxel said.
GSI officials were not available for comment.
The Voxcam imager is a key element of Voxel's Digital Holography System.
Voxel said it has given GSI notice citing GSI's failure to meet its engineering and manufacturing obligations. The notice starts a 60-day period of informal talks between the parties.

At the conclusion of the 60 days, in the absence of an acceptable solution, Voxel expects to invoke its contractual right to binding arbitration to pursue monetary damages and other appropriate remedies.
Unless a suitable resolution is reached with GSI, Voxel will work to establish an alternative source of supply and then determine a new Voxcam schedule.
The Digital Holography System produces "three-dimensional X-rays" of the internal structure of the body.
